protocol.reanalysis: Replay the same 20 retained banks after implementation repair. No new samples, tasks, seeds, budgets, fee, alpha, objective or family allocation.
protocol.secondary_question: Does propagation certify improvements behind an unchanged root against the weak stochastic actor?
protocol.seeds: all 4 original plus all 16 heldout-bank records from prior gap study
protocol.truth_use: Validation only after certificates and policies fixed
